Independent research and software project, derived from a master’s thesis.

MedSegAPI: from segmentation research to an API

A lung-segmentation service that connects model research with an API, a visual result viewer, and an operating workflow.

Python · PyTorch · FastAPI · Docker · GitHub Actions · Streamlit

The question

A trained segmentation model needs an accessible interface, repeatable inference, and a way to inspect its outputs.

The work

  • Serve CNN, Vision Transformer and hybrid segmentation models through FastAPI.
  • Package inference in Docker and expose single-image and batch endpoints.
  • Add a visual viewer, API-key access, prediction logging, monitoring and CI/CD.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Repository includes a working implementation and saved examples showing the original X-ray, predicted mask and overlay.
  • The public code documents the path from model experimentation to a service interface.

What I learned

  • Connect research quality with deployment, observability and usability.

Project context

  • Research and educational project; no clinical validation claim.
  • Live availability and benchmark results were not independently rerun.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
